title: Best *OP* ESP Aimbot Tracer BlindShot Box ESP Bypass AC
features:
Join our Discord server for support, bug reports, previews, suggestions, and more!

Features:

* WindUI-based menu - Enabled, Auto-Downloads WindUI From GitHub, With Fallback GUI
* RightShift toggles the UI - Enabled, Keybind Configurable
* Welcome card with Roblox headshot + "Script Loaded Successfully" notification and sound - Enabled
* BlindShot ESP / tracer beam - Enabled, Neon Beam From Enemy'S Aim Direction
* Box ESP via Highlight - Enabled, Outline/Fill Enemy Characters
* Color logic: team color or fixed color, enemy color kicks in when aim is "dangerous" - Enabled, Dot Product Vs WarningThreshold
* Team check and health check options - Enabled
* Detects if an opponent's aim ray intersects your character and sidesteps / repositions - Enabled
* Movement safety: wall check, ground check, max drop, pitch limits, cooldown, optional tween movement, lift amount, close-range tweaks - Enabled, Adjustable
* Picks nearest valid target within AimRange - Enabled, Adjustable
* Optional axis-aligned radius box filter - Enabled, AimRadiusX/Y/Z + AimUseRadius
* Forces camera lookAt and rotates root to face target - Enabled
* Stores last safe CFrame when grounded, teleports back if falling / below world Y / no ground detected, with small lift and velocity zeroing - Enabled
* Finds nearest enemy within AutoFistRange - Enabled, Adjustable
* Tweens you toward them if too far - Enabled
* Equips Fists and fires the remote / activates tool / simulates mouse click - Enabled
* Desync - Enabled, Toggles Network Sleeping On HumanoidRootPart, Flag Flips, Brief FPS Caps
* Fix Desync - Enabled, Flag Toggle Off/On
* Pistol - Enabled, 0
* Revolver - Enabled, 150
* Laser Gun - Enabled, 350
* Shotgun - Enabled, 700
* RPG - Enabled, 1000
* Cobra - Enabled, 1500

Join our Discord server to see our supported games!
